segments.zh: 我不记得我到底做了什么，但我爸爸对我很不高兴，是的，他真的很严格，所以我被禁足的次数还挺多。

segments.en: I tend to think that girls get in trouble less.
segments.zh: 我倾向于认为女孩会少遇到麻烦。

segments.en: I think so.
I don't know if it's because they're good.
segments.zh: 我不知道是不是因为他们很好。

segments.en: I think probably it's because they're better at hiding things from their parents.
segments.zh: 我想可能是因为他们更擅长向父母隐瞒事情。

segments.en: Maybe.
Because whenever I would come home, my mother would always wake up, but she doesn't really understand what time it is, and so I'd say, oh, mom, it's 11 o'clock.
segments.zh: 因为每当我回家时，我妈妈总是会醒来，但她并不真正了解现在几点，所以我会说，哦，妈妈，现在是 11 点。

segments.en: Good night.
And it'd be like 4 o'clock in the morning, and she had no idea.
segments.zh: 其实那时候已经是凌晨四点了，她完全不知道。

segments.en: So who was the person or the parent that put their foot down?
segments.zh: 那么，态度强硬的是谁，是哪位家长呢？

segments.en: Was it your mom or your dad?
My dad was the serious one.
Oh, really?

Yeah, it's interesting because sometimes it's the dad that's very strict, and the mom kind of helps you out and tries to kind of not get you grounded or something, but sometimes it's the other way around.
segments.zh: 是的，这很有趣，因为有时是爸爸非常严格，而妈妈会帮你说话，尽量不让你被禁足之类的，但有时情况正好相反。

segments.en: The mom is really strict and firm, and the dad's like, come on, don't ground him.
segments.zh: 妈妈真的很严格、很强硬，爸爸却说，算了吧，别禁他的足了。

segments.en: They're just having fun.

Well, I think in some families, the children understand who is strict and who is maybe not so strict, and so they say, oh, well, mom said that it's okay, so I think maybe you should let me go out, and the dad will be very angry because the mother said that it's okay.
segments.zh: 好吧，我想在一些家庭中，孩子们明白谁是严格的，谁可能不那么严格，所以他们说，哦，好吧，妈妈说没关系，所以我想也许你应该让我出去，爸爸会很生气，因为妈妈说没关系。

segments.en: That's right.
All right, so that's all the time we have for today.
We're really curious to get your stories, maybe tell us why were you grounded or how long were you grounded for?
segments.zh: 我们真的很想知道你的故事，也许告诉我们你为什么被禁足，或者被禁足了多长时间？

segments.en: Or what was your curfew when you were a child or growing up?
segments.zh: 或者你小时候或长大时的宵禁是什么？

segments.en: Our website is EnglishPod.com.
We hope to see you there.
All right.
We'll see you guys there.
Bye.
Well, see you guys there.
